rationaleAppend: isaiah-woh wave I-5: at Isa 34:4 the sky that is rolled up like a scroll (wᵉnāḡōllû kas-sēp̄er haš-šāmayim) is the physical sky, 'the skies'; the same verse keeps the fixed phrase 'the host of the heavens' (tzeva-ha-shamayim-host-of-the-heavens-divine-council-cross-corpus), so one Hebrew word has two English forms in one verse, and the commentary says so. At 34:5 baš-šāmayim, where YHWH's sword drinks its fill before coming down on Edom, is also 'in the skies' (NJPS 'in the sky'); the verse names where the sword acts, not YHWH's dwelling, so the divine-realm 'heavens' of Isa 14:12-13 is not used.

isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 34:4, already named above for the astral sense, renders kol-ṣᵉḇāʾ haš-šāmayim 'all the host of the heavens' and kol-ṣᵉḇāʾām 'all their host'; the second šāmayim of the verse, outside the fixed phrase, is 'the skies' under the central shamayim entry.

isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 34:2 heḥĕrîmām 'he has devoted them to destruction' (ASV and JPS 1917 'utterly destroyed'; NJPS 'doomed'); at 34:5 the suffixed noun ʿam ḥermî, literally 'the people of my ban', is rendered verbally, 'the people I have devoted to destruction', as NJPS renders it ('the people I have doomed'), so that 'devote' stays visible and the verb of 34:2 is heard again; JPS 1917 'the people of My ban' and ASV 'the people of my curse' are given in commentary.

isaiah-woh wave I-5: at Isa 34:11, named above, the pair is split across a parallelism, qaw-tōhû wᵉʾaḇnê-ḇōhû, and rendered 'the line of wasteland and the plummet of emptiness' so that the Gen 1:2 rendering can be recognised (ASV and JPS 1917 'the line of confusion, and the plummet of emptiness'; NJPS 'a line of chaos … weights of emptiness'). The bare singular tōhû elsewhere in Isaiah stays with the isaiah-woh overlay entries (tohu-bare-emptiness-wasteland-isaiah; qiryat-tohu-city-of-chaos-isaiah-24).
isaiah-woh wave I-5: ʿōrēḇ 'the raven' at Isa 34:11, already cited above among the birds of desolation.

isaiah-woh wave I-5: territorial 'land' at Isa 34:6 (bᵉʾereṣ ʾĕḏôm 'in the land of Edom'), 34:7 ('their land') and 34:9 ('its land'); the cosmic hā-ʾāreṣ of 34:1 is 'the earth' under the isaiah-woh overlay eretz-cosmic-scope-isaiah-24.
